scope.purpose: Freeze the physical SCD40 measurement and evidence contract for later C-C2 controlled intake.

observed_limitations: The current capture script polls Pi /health and is not a direct SCD40 I2C event logger.
The current ESP32 telemetry exposes CO2 but drops Temperature and Humidity after readMeasurement.
The current transport freshness flag describes last-packet age, not a new SCD40 conversion.
The current telemetry contract has no fresh-read sequence or sensor-event timestamp.
team_acquisition_reference.precollection_rule: Do not collect a C-C1 session with the legacy capture path unchanged. A declared adapter revision must pass the precollection compliance checklist first.

required_features.name: CO2
required_features.source: CO2 value from the same verified fresh SCD40 read event as Temperature and Relative Humidity

required_features.name: Temperature
required_features.source: Temperature returned by the same SCD40 readMeasurement call as CO2 and Relative Humidity

required_features.name: Humidity
required_features.source: Relative Humidity returned by the same SCD40 readMeasurement call as CO2 and Temperature

required_features.name: CO2_slope
required_features.source: C-C2 reconstruction from verified fresh-event chronology using the frozen ENDPOINT_H150 contract

field_contract.validation_rule: Must equal 1.0.0 for this protocol.

field_contract.validation_rule: Unknown requires a written reason and is a C-C2 limitation.

field_contract.validation_rule: Strictly increasing for fresh events within a session; reset requires a new session.

field_contract.reason: Preserves readiness, read failure, and successful-read boundaries.
field_contract.validation_rule: Must use a declared status such as FRESH_READ, DATA_NOT_READY, SENSOR_READ_FAILED, or SENSOR_INVALID.

field_contract.capture_timing: same measurement_event_id as CO2 and Relative Humidity

field_contract.validation_rule: Finite numeric value only when sensor_read_status is FRESH_READ.

field_contract.capture_timing: same measurement_event_id as CO2 and Temperature
field_contract.reason: Closes the C-C0 T/RH telemetry-loss gap and supplies frozen B5 Humidity.
field_contract.validation_rule: Finite numeric value only when sensor_read_status is FRESH_READ.

field_contract.reason: Prevents a numeric cached value from being mistaken for a valid fresh feature.
field_contract.validation_rule: Must include co2, temperature, and humidity booleans.

field_contract.validation_rule: Raw payload is never overwritten, relabeled, or interpolated.

field_contract.validation_rule: Must remain constant within a session.

field_contract.validation_rule: If inaccessible, record the explicit status; never fabricate a serial.

field_contract.validation_rule: Record a version, commit, or explicit unavailable status.

field_contract.validation_rule: A decrease requires a new session and DEVICE_RESTART event.

field_contract.reason: Identifies packet chronology without treating packets as fresh reads.
field_contract.validation_rule: Gaps and resets are preserved and classified.

field_contract.reason: Separates transport receipt time from sensor-event time.
field_contract.validation_rule: Use UTC with milliseconds or better declared precision.

field_contract.reason: Supports host-local packet chronology without wall-clock adjustments.
field_contract.validation_rule: Strictly increasing for received packets within a session.

field_contract.reason: Preserves connection state separately from sensor validity.
field_contract.validation_rule: False never becomes a valid feature row.

field_contract.reason: Preserves transport freshness without equating it to sensor freshness.
field_contract.validation_rule: Must not be used as the fresh SCD40 event marker.

field_contract.reason: Makes stale boundaries auditable.
field_contract.validation_rule: Nonnegative when present; retain stale/disconnect rows.

field_contract.validation_rule: A non-live state is not a valid fresh measurement event.

field_contract.reason: Provides a host wall-clock reference for handoff and GT alignment.
field_contract.validation_rule: UTC timezone required; edits after capture are forbidden.

field_contract.capture_timing: every raw event and every GT marker
field_contract.reason: Provides host-local elapsed chronology independent of wall-clock corrections.
field_contract.validation_rule: Strictly increasing within a session.

field_contract.reason: Supports loss/gap accounting without deleting rows.
field_contract.validation_rule: Unique within a raw file; gaps are recorded, not renumbered later.

field_contract.reason: Periodic mode and warm-up affect fresh-event chronology.
field_contract.validation_rule: Record the actual mode; do not assume the library default.

field_contract.reason: Explains the relation between data-ready events and logger polls.
field_contract.validation_rule: Record configured value and source; it is not a substitute for observed event times.

field_contract.reason: Records the downstream SafeNest model-input cadence separately from native SCD40 measurement configuration.
field_contract.validation_rule: Must equal 60.0 seconds nominally; configured_measurement_interval_ms is not a substitute.

field_contract.reason: Records the nominal normal CO2 export cadence when the same event is transmitted as the model-input record.
field_contract.validation_rule: Must equal 60.0 seconds nominally and must not be satisfied by stale reuse.

field_contract.reason: ASC affects long-duration environmental interpretation.
field_contract.validation_rule: Unknown is explicit and creates a C-C2 limitation; never fill a default.

field_contract.reason: Offset can alter T/RH feature interpretation.
field_contract.validation_rule: Record value, unavailable status, or explicit configuration read failure.

field_contract.reason: Compensation changes sensor output behavior.
field_contract.validation_rule: Do not infer from room location without recording the source.

field_contract.validation_rule: Record source and time if present; do not invent a nominal pressure.

field_contract.reason: FRC history affects provenance even when exact calibration state is unavailable.
field_contract.validation_rule: Record known events; do not reconstruct unknown history.

field_contract.reason: Power cycles reset clocks and may change sensor warm-up state.
field_contract.validation_rule: A restart or power cycle requires a new session.

field_contract.reason: Links raw measurements to an independent occupancy label without using CO2 or B5 output.
field_contract.validation_rule: Reference must resolve to a GT event with start/end or transition time.

field_contract.validation_rule: Only VACANT or OCCUPIED; never infer from CO2, PIR, slope, or B5.

field_contract.reason: Documents that the label is controlled and independent.
field_contract.validation_rule: Use CONTROLLED_EMPTY_ROOM, CONTROLLED_PERSON_PRESENT, RECORDED_ENTRY, or RECORDED_EXIT.

field_contract.source: same logger clock as the event marker
field_contract.reason: Allows later temporal alignment without post-hoc label editing.
field_contract.validation_rule: Record at event time; handwritten reconstruction after B5 inspection is forbidden.

field_contract.capture_timing: precheck and whenever door/window/ventilation state changes
field_contract.reason: Records material CO2 confounders without an unnecessary maximal checklist.
field_contract.validation_rule: Include location, door, window, ventilation, and HVAC state when relevant.

field_contract.reason: Preserves abnormal events and explains missing or invalid rows.
field_contract.validation_rule: Use declared failure statuses; never delete or silently repair the affected raw event.

field_contract.reason: Keeps external accumulation independent and auditable.
field_contract.validation_rule: Record reason, timestamp, affected session, and compliance consequence.

fresh_event_definition: CO2, Temperature, and Relative Humidity are finite values from that same read call.
sensor_event_monotonic_ms is captured at the successful read boundary.
The three feature values share one measurement_event_id.
allowed_event_markers: ESP monotonic timestamp captured at read completion
measurement_event_contract.unsupported_assumption_prohibited: Do not treat a logger poll, a new telemetry sequence, Pi revision, or transport fresh flag as proof of a new SCD40 conversion.
measurement_event_contract.event_coherence_rule: CO2, Temperature, and Relative Humidity must never be assembled from different cached or packet events.
measurement_event_contract.implementation_gate: The deployed acquisition adapter must demonstrate these fields in a precollection fixture/replay check. If it cannot, stop before physical collection.

effective_model_input_cadence.native_sensor_measurement_cadence_contra: Record configured_measurement_interval_ms and verified fresh-event chronology separately; this contract does not require or assert a 60000 ms native SCD40 measurement interval.

normal_export.timestamp_policy: Preserve observed chronology; do not edit timestamps to force 60-second spacing.

failure_observability.policy: Preserve sensor, transport, logger, and deviation evidence when observed; a 60-second normal-data cadence must not hide failure evidence.

one_missed_sample_consequence.statement: At nominal 60-second effective cadence, one missed valid sample can create an approximately 120-second valid-event gap; because 120 seconds is greater than the frozen 90-second H150 gap limit, history resets and CO2_slope remains unavailable until causal history is rebuilt.

freshness_contract.stale_or_disconnect_policy: Preserve the event/row and failure status; do not use it as a fresh feature row.
freshness_contract.freshness_clock: Use sensor_event_monotonic_ms for sensor chronology and logger/pi monotonic clocks for host chronology.

history_reset_on: fresh-event chronology gap greater than 90 seconds
transport disconnect or stale interval that prevents verified fresh events
h150_contract.c_c1_claim: C-C1 freezes the evidence needed for future reconstruction; it does not claim that H150 has already been reconstructed on a physical device.

required_clocks.clock_source: ESP monotonic clock captured at successful SCD40 read
required_clocks.restart_behavior: resets or discontinuity requires a new session
new logger process/session must be recorded
wall-clock correction is recorded as a deviation if observed
required_clocks.synchronization_claim: wall-clock provenance; no cross-host precision claim

required_clocks.restart_behavior: receiver restart is a failure/restart event
required_clocks.synchronization_claim: packet receipt time, not sensor event time

required_clocks.clock_source: same logger clock as the GT marker
required_clocks.precision: operator/logger precision declared in session manifest
required_clocks.restart_behavior: GT logger restart requires a new GT segment and deviation record

timestamp_contract.ordering_rule: Use monotonic clocks for elapsed chronology; use UTC fields for provenance and same-logger GT alignment.

new_session_required_on: interruption greater than 90 seconds without verified fresh chronology
session_contract.warmup_rule: Start periodic measurement, record all warm-up/failure events, and mark WARMUP_COMPLETE only at the first verified fresh SCD40 event.
session_contract.h150_history_rule: A session is H150-eligible only after at least 150 seconds of verified same-session fresh-event chronology with no forbidden internal gap.

scenario_completion_rules.VACANT_STABLE: Known VACANT ground truth, WARMUP_COMPLETE, then at least 150 seconds of verified fresh chronology before session end.
scenario_completion_rules.OCCUPIED_STABLE: Known OCCUPIED ground truth, WARMUP_COMPLETE, then at least 150 seconds of verified fresh chronology before session end.
scenario_completion_rules.VACANT_TO_OCCUPIED: At least 150 seconds of verified fresh chronology in the VACANT segment, a logger-time entry marker, then at least 150 seconds of verified fresh chronology in the OCCUPIED segment.
scenario_completion_rules.OCCUPIED_TO_VACANT: At least 150 seconds of verified fresh chronology in the OCCUPIED segment, a logger-time exit marker, then at least 150 seconds of verified fresh chronology in the VACANT segment.

session_contract.aggregate_session_count: NOT_FROZEN_BY_C_C1; requires a separately authorized acquisition schedule and must never be adapted from B5 results.
session_contract.session_failure_policy: Preserve incomplete sessions and classify them; do not discard them from the handoff.

device_identity_contract.identity_separation_rule: SCD40 physical identity, ESP/controller identity, and Pi/logger identity are separate fields.
device_identity_contract.fabrication_policy: Never fabricate a sensor serial or infer one from esp_device_id.

configuration_metadata_contract.configuration_change_policy: Any configuration change closes the current session and starts a new session with a new manifest.

environment_context_contract.unknown_policy: Record UNKNOWN_WITH_REASON; do not create a maximal checklist unrelated to CO2 interpretation.

ground_truth_contract.formal_metrics_rule: Only CONFIRMED_OPERATOR_CONTROLLED segments with explicit timing may enter formal C-C2 occupancy metrics.

failure_state_contract.row_policy: Preserve raw rows/events and failure registry entries. Never forward-fill, interpolate, zero-fill, delete, or silently relabel.
failure_state_contract.normal_cadence_missing_sample_policy: At a scheduled nominal 60-second point with no verified fresh SCD40 event, preserve the missing/failure state and do not emit a valid normal model-input/export record.
failure_state_contract.failure_observability_policy: Failure and deviation evidence is preserved when observed and is not held until the next nominal 60-second valid record.
failure_state_contract.restart_policy: Close the affected session, record the restart, and start a new session before fresh chronology resumes.

raw_immutability_contract.canonical_raw_format: JSONL one event per line, UTF-8, newline-delimited, no post-capture edits
capture_finalization_order: record byte size and event/line counts
compute SHA-256 for every handoff file except the checksum file itself
write the checksum manifest with repository-relative or bundle-relative paths
generate derived summaries only from the frozen raw bundle
raw_immutability_contract.mutation_status: Any later hash mismatch must be classified as RAW_EVIDENCE_MUTATION_DETECTED.
raw_immutability_contract.derived_data_rule: Derived summaries, plots, and reports never replace or overwrite raw evidence.

external_accumulation_contract.deviation_policy: Every unavoidable deviation receives a reason, timestamp, affected session, and protocol compliance classification.

blocking_violations: missing any required raw B5 source feature
CO2/Temperature/Humidity not linked to one measurement_event_id
missing session_id or unknown session boundary
silent timestamp, label, or raw-value edit
configuration changed without a new session and record
stale or cached data reused to satisfy the nominal 60-second cadence
normal export record lacks same-fresh-event CO2/Temperature/Humidity coherence
independent ground truth missing for a claimed formal metric segment
adaptive collection based on B5 output
protocol_compliance_classification.noncompliant_data_policy: Preserve and classify noncompliant sessions; do not silently discard them.

pre_metric_checks: effective 60-second model-input and normal-export cadence compliance

validator_must_check: frozen B5 identity and artifact hashes
one missed 60-second sample resets H150 after an approximately 120-second valid-event gap
operator prompt and technical protocol exist

unresolved_precollection_items.resolution_rule: The operator must record the deployed firmware/adapter/library revisions and pass a fixture/replay check for T/RH same-event coherence and fresh_read_sequence before collecting any session.
Query the device/library. If unavailable, record UNIQUE_SENSOR_IDENTITY_NOT_AVAILABLE rather than fabricating an ID.

The deployed adapter/receiver must record the downstream 60-second nominal model-input and normal-export cadence separately from native SCD40 configuration, prove same-fresh-event CO2/Temperature/Humidity coherence, and preserve missing/failure status without stale reuse.
A separately authorized measurement owner defines the safe session schedule; it must not be selected adaptively from B5 output.
